_method: English Wikipedia pageviews, 12 complete months, all-access, user traffic only (bots excluded). Regenerate with Tools/rank-philosophers.py. Pageviews measure readership, not importance, and carry two biases worth naming: they count English-language readers, and they reward people famous for something other than philosophy — Marx, Freud, Jung, Machiavelli and Rand all outrank Kant. The cutoff at 50 is arbitrary and the numbers either side of it are 2% apart.

text.en: Shortly thou wilt forget all things, and shortly all things will forget thee.
